description: A splat over the sum of an unknown number and 1 gives a one-element tuple
notes: The spec doesn't say whether a splat over an unknown that can't be null has a known result. hashicorp/hcl knows that arithmetic never gives null (a go-cty refinement), so it wraps the unknown number in a tuple (SplatExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go); a splat over an unknown variable, which might be null, gives the dynamic value (splat-unknown-number).
